alternatives.argument: The local Gaussian-series lemma derives weighted squared-norm MGFs, fourth moments, norm tails and upper-quantile bounds from given normalized coordinates and countable monotone limits. For the unchanged selector, rejection of each predecessor and a finite union bound give explicit p_m and P_k; fourth moments bound late selected noise by A_k, monotone bias gives the first late alternative, and a second relative bound gives B_k. A geometric split gives the explicit additive v0 M^[1/(2(1+gamma))] consequence. A variance-crossing j plus fixed J proves uniform deterministic oracle comparison without an alpha-grid density assumption. The actual mild/severe variance lower bounds control the effective-dimension term and recover exactly both original rate upper bounds, including nu=0 and vartheta≤1/2. All proofs are in the current local carriers; no 2019supplement theorem is assumed.
